review_basis: Visual review of 360x240 one-second samples across the full duration of every exact-source PSS movie in labeled 5x5 contact sheets viewed at full PNG resolution. Each file was classified as one asset; frame evidence identifies representative Japanese and English pixels but does not claim that every frame contains wording.
